verdict.rationale: Supermemory uses AI to derive structured knowledge from your data: it extracts memories automatically from raw content, maintains user profiles of facts built from interactions (grouped into topical buckets), and builds a knowledge graph. That is AI-generated synthesis, but nothing in the evidence shows proactive insights or suggestions surfaced inside a product UI. Results are mainly consumed through the API or through MCP-connected assistants, and the consumer app is only mentioned in passing. Missing for 10: documented in-product insight/suggestion features, a description of what the consumer app surfaces, proactive recommendations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
